name: Issue
about: Technical issue related to the code in this repository

---

> 🚨 This repository is for the **fleet-telemetry** reference WebSocket server only.
>
> **Out of scope (use [Support Inquiry](https://developer.tesla.com/dashboard) instead):**
> - Fleet API vehicle commands such as `navigation_request` (including HTTP 503 / regional backend timeouts — see [#435](https://github.com/teslamotors/fleet-telemetry/issues/435))
> - `developer.tesla.com` / `developer.tesla.cn` login or dashboard problems
> - Account, token, or billing issues
>
> For signed-command proxy bugs, prefer [teslamotors/vehicle-command](https://github.com/teslamotors/vehicle-command).
